Administering KoldFusion Server

Verity

KoldFusion includes a compact full-text search engine in the style of Verity SEARCH'97. A collection is a searchable index of documents. The Verity page creates collections, fills them and keeps them tidy. Templates use them with CFINDEX, CFSEARCH and CFCOLLECTION.

Go there: Open the Verity page (or inside the frameset)

Add a Collection

Field Default Meaning
Name (blank) A unique name for the collection
Path kfroot/verity/collections Directory in which the collection is stored
Language English Stored with the collection
Create / Map Create Create builds a new, empty collection. Map registers a collection that already exists at the given path.

Click Create.

Working with a collection

Select a collection in the list (it shows the path and number of documents) and click a button:

Button Does
Index... Opens a form to index files: File Extensions (default .htm, .html, .cfm, .cfml), Directory Path (default the web root), Recursively index sub directories, and the Return URL that search results will link to. Click Submit to see how many documents were indexed.
Repair Reads the collection and writes it back in clean form
Optimize The same as Repair; KoldFusion collections are always compact
Purge Removes every document, leaving an empty collection
Delete Removes the collection, after you confirm

Searching

<cfsearch name="hits" collection="sitedocs" criteria="frosty">
<cfoutput query="hits"><a href="#URL#">#Title#</a> (#Score#)<br></cfoutput>

Note  Re-index after you change your site, or new pages will not show up in search results. A nightly Scheduled Task that runs a CFINDEX ACTION="Refresh" template does the job.
